name: MailHandled
summary: An AI chief of staff for every Gmail and Outlook account you own. It sorts your mail, drafts replies in your voice and files what matters. Replies go out only when you approve them.
accessNote: Private beta · invite only during Google verification
highlights: Connect every email account you own; one place sorts them all
Drafts replies in your voice; nothing is sent until you press Send
Combines the calendars across your accounts into one
Saves attachments to your Drive automatically
Tracks the subscriptions and bills your mail mentions, and can cancel the ones you don't use, only with your consent
A short summary each morning of what needs you

updates.title: The calendar takes your own reminders, and the bill scan reads rent, insurance and tax mail
Home's calendar holds everything with a date on it
Ask writes the reply for you to approve
Bills as a spreadsheet you can download
Download my data, and "While you were away" on Home
Home on one screen: emails, meetings, files and bills open over it
Subscriptions shown only while your mail still proves them

release.note: The calendar lists by one rule
